why: Tests round after the build of ticket 1042, in next/. The pinned setting names and the Worker's start values now hold tezgah.new; the window law's two type annotations no longer collide with the file's own Pick; the shell suite's Backend carries the error type its steps can fail with, so the tab's reader failures stay failures. Every owed plant ran once on the build's code and was put back. Two found holes, both fixed: N4 had no case for a live code swap, so handing no settings to the swap's init stayed green, and it now swaps a running v1 process to v2 in place; N7 only failed on the test's time limit when the start went ahead, and it now races dev.ts's exit against its ready line. The shell suite's shots step stays red on tuval's stale prefix read, field/findings/2026-11-15-tuval-prefix-reads-stale-state.json, which its own pull request fixes.
